chapter: Image, travel and Black, Brown and Beige
title: Welcomed at train stations by local bands
summary: Local bands and crowds met the Ellington train in every town.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: You know, my mother told me when she was a teen, she was born in 1920, she was a teenager when the bands
used to come to Los Angeles and they used to meet the bands, she and the kids in her high school, they used to meet your -- at Union Station.
At the station. And we'd play, straight off to Central Avenue, around. Yeah, had them cars, the bands were playing. Just beautiful parties, you know.
Now, did you all -- were you all met at many train stations by people when you came into town?

Always. No matter what time of night it was or what time of day it was. / We'd come in the station, some local band would be at the station playing, and we'd come through the station playing. People would turn around, wonder what's going on. And they had their banners. All cities, that was it. That's the truth.
